applies_to: Greystone CDD3 series room CO2 transmitters with the BACnet MS/TP output, with optional RH, temperature, relay and setpoint.
summary: The CDD3 is a Greystone CO2 transmitter with native BACnet MS/TP. It reports CO2 and, when fitted, RH, temperature and a setpoint adjust value as Analog Inputs, with Analog and Binary Values for relay setup, calibration offsets and units. Objects for options that are not installed stay in the list but report a fault.
notes: Points from the object summary table and per-object pages of the setup guide.
AI 2, AI 3 and AI 4 exist only with the RH, temperature and setpoint options; the relay objects need the relay option.
Multistate objects are Multi-State Values (MSV) in the guide; listed here as MV.
The summary table calls BV 4 "Override Test"; its object page prints the name "Override Operation".
Access from the PICS: Present_Value is writable on AV, BV and MSV objects.

source.title: CDD3 Series Carbon Dioxide Transmitter - Setup Guide BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Give each sensor a unique MS/TP MAC and device instance from the menu, then read CO2 (AI 1) and any fitted RH and temperature inputs. The relay setpoint and offsets are setup values.
setup: Default MS/TP MAC address is 3 and default baud is 9600; both are set in the Setup menu.
Device instance defaults to 381000 + MAC (381003); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
Lower Max_Master from 127 to the highest MAC on the segment to cut token-passing overhead.
gotchas: Objects for options that are not fitted report Reliability NO_SENSOR and Event_State FAULT; do not poll them.
The sensor updates about every 4 s; poll every 5-10 s, not faster.
